ns2:course.label: Ruminant Nutrition
ns2:course.description: Physiology and microbiology of digestion in the ruminant, and biochemical pathways of utilization of the absorbed nutrients for productive purposes. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ANSC 223 or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ANSC 223 or equivalent.
